query:
SELECT
            id          as "id: Id",
            user_id     as "user_id: user::Id",
            body        as "body: Body",
            created_at  as "created_at: CreatedAt"
        FROM notes
        WHERE user_id = ?1
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN ?3 = 'ascending' THEN
                    CASE ?2
                        WHEN 'id' THEN id
                        WHEN 'body' THEN body
                        WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at
                    END
                END ASC NULLS LAST,
            CASE
                WHEN ?3 = 'descending' THEN
                    CASE ?2
                        WHEN 'id' THEN id
                        WHEN 'body' THEN body
                        WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at
                    END
            END DESC NULLS LAST,
            -- keeps paging deterministic when the sort key ties
            id ASC
        LIMIT ?4 OFFSET ?5
